ns2:section.sectionText: This is a fully online course with no face to face meetings. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. AO undergrad tuition rate is $304 per credit hour and all students are assessed a $50 per credit hour administration fee. This section is for nonresidential, undergraduate, nondegree off-campus students only, on-campus students should register for the on-campus section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $339.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $304.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
